div.p: BOPLA features over 25,000 electronic component products and has been developing and manufacturing enclosures and membrane keypads for more than 50 years. Founded in 1977, this company has been a part of the Swiss group of companies of Phoenix Mecano AG, which operates internationally, and their enclosures can be found in various sectors, such as safety and security technology, telecommunications, automotive technology, and the field of medicine.

Advantech is a leader in providing trusted innovative embedded and automation products and solutions. The company offers comprehensive system integration, hardware, software, customer-centric design services, and global logistics support; all backed by industry-leading front and back office e-business solutions. Advantech is an innovator and cooperates closely with partners to help provide complete solutions for a wide array of applications across a diverse range of industries.

Advantech is a Premier Member of The Intel® Internet of Things Solutions Alliance, one of the world's most recognized and trusted technology ecosystems. Members of The Intel® Internet of Things Solutions Alliance include leading solution and service providers from a broad range of industries, who provide the hardware, software, firmware, tools, and systems integration that developers need to take a leading role in the rise of intelligent systems.

section.p: 1BitSquared, based in Eugene, Oregon, executes hardware and software design, development, and manufacturing for a wide range of embedded system tools and devices. Their mission is to provide high-quality, cutting-edge, affordable, open-source hardware and software for embedded hardware engineers, students, and enthusiasts.

2J Antennas is a world-class, trusted leader in antenna solutions that aims to deliver advanced technologies for the connected world. The company innovates and offers high-quality products and services with cutting-edge technologies to meet the rapidly evolving wireless industry catering to 5G, 4G LTE, 3G, 2G, WiFi, Iridium communications, GPS/GNSS/BeiDou frequencies, and more.

1GLOBAL is a company that innovates eSIM-based GSM mobile services. They cater to businesses and individuals with products, including mobile phone calls and SMS recording services. These products are designed for businesses, remote SIM provisioning, IoT solutions, Telco-as-a-Service for travel companies, and affordable roaming for everyday consumers. As pioneers in eSIM technology, 1GLOBAL strives to develop the products and solutions our society needs to stay connected anywhere, anytime with anyone.

3M is a leading supplier of innovative solutions for the electrical, electronics, and communications industries. A diversified technology company, 3M has a worldwide presence in several markets, including OEM, consumer electronics, telecommunications, computers and peripherals, aerospace, military, automotive, and medical markets.

Alif Semiconductor was founded to address the rapidly growing market need for scalable and secure AI-enabled 32-bit, genuinely power-efficient microcontrollers. This market need led to Alif Semiconductor’s creation of a new class of embedded microcontrollers, or fusion processors. These processors enable seamless integration of technology for everyday life by unlocking innovative low-power techniques, unparalleled functional integration, accelerated artificial intelligence and machine learning edge processing, high security, and operating system diversity.

Apogee Semiconductor strives to be the premier supplier of radiation hardened power, analog, and mixed signal ICs. They are rapidly growing their portfolio to provide a comprehensive suite of products, and have a team of experienced design, systems, and process engineers who are taking a different approach to radiation hardened by design (RHBD) IC design.

AAEON UP is a leading designer and manufacturer of professional, intelligent IoT solutions, including the UP Board. The UP Board offers extensive features that make it ideal for applications such as robotics, drones, machine vision, smart home, education, digital signage, intelligent cars, and IoT solutions.

4D LCD is a specialist provider of custom LCD display solutions, focused on delivering versatile, high-quality modules tailored to meet the exact needs of today’s devices and industries. From compact wearables to industrial interfaces and AI-powered systems, 4D LCD supports product designers and engineers with flexible options in size, brightness, touch capability, and mounting. Built on a commitment to precision, performance, and seamless integration, every display is engineered to enhance user experience and bring users' technology to life.
Bend Labs is a technology company on a mission to bring motion measurement and understanding to the world through flexible soft sensing solutions.

B&K Precision for over 70 years has been building a reputation for excellence in the design and manufacture of reliable and cost-effective test and measurement solutions. B&K Precision instruments are used in design, research and development, production line testing, industrial maintenance, and education field service. The company's general-purpose instruments include signal generators, oscilloscopes, multimeters, DC power supplies, DC electronic loads, component testers, data acquisition recorders, and battery test solutions.

Amphenol TPC is a leading supplier of high-performance wire, cable, connectors, and assemblies engineered to withstand harsh industrial environments. The company provides innovative and abuse-resistant industrial wire and cable solutions suitable for a wide range of industries, including automotive, industrial automation, rail and transit, marine, oil and gas, and food and beverage.

Sensore Electronic is an Austrian manufacturer specializing in precision oxygen sensors and electronic control modules for demanding and safety-critical applications. Its portfolio includes moisture-resistant potentiometric oxygen sensors, SIL Level II-ready sensor modules, and optimized electronics designed for stable, long-term operation. Advanced capabilities such as automated production, continuous melt furnace sintering, and high precision calibration enable durable, application-specific sensing solutions with consistent accuracy and reliability.

Dynament manufactures miniature nondispersive infrared (NDIR) gas sensors designed for accurate, long-term detection of methane, carbon dioxide, refrigerants, and nitrous oxide. Its patented Standard, Platinum, and Axiom sensor families integrate optics, electronics, and firmware to deliver stable, low-power performance and direct pellistor replacement. Solutions are widely used in industrial safety, HVAC, and environmental monitoring applications requiring certified, high-reliability gas sensing.

div.p: Analog Devices / Maxim Integrated, provides ease of design, and speeds time to market, through analog integration. The company’s analog ICs offer extra features and functionality carefully designed to streamline circuit and simplify design. Look to Maxim for solutions for consumer electronics, personal computers and peripherals, mobile devices, wireless and fiber communications, test equipment, instrumentation, video displays, and automotive applications. Maxim’s analog and mixed-signal solutions include data converters, interface circuits, power, RF wireless circuits, clocks and oscillators, microcontrollers (MCUs), operational amplifiers (op amps), and sensors.

div.strong: Mini Oxygen Sensor Board Mounts & Flanged Kits - Sensore Electronic

div.h2: Sensore Electronic Mini Oxygen Sensor Board Mounts & Flanged Kits
div.p: Sensore Electronic Mini Oxygen Sensor Board Mounts and Flanged Kits are designed using Zirconium Dioxide (ZrO2) technology to deliver highly accurate readings. These board mounts and flanged kits feature single point lifetime calibration, stable characteristics across a range, and minimal interference with other gases. The mini oxygen sensor board mounts and flanged kits also feature a 0.7V to 1.6V bias voltage range and 1.5W power consumption (depends on application). These board mounts and flanged kits include an optional electronics control board with industry-standard outputs.

The SO-B0-x mini oxygen sensor board mounts and SO-B1-x mini oxygen sensor flanged kits feature measuring ranges from 1000ppm to 96% oxygen. These board mounts and flanged kits are used in medical, measuring instrumentation, security technology, electrical industries, laboratories, and food industries.

div.p: Sensore Electronic OXY-FLEX Oxygen Transmitters are compact and cost-effective zirconia transmitters designed to measure the percentage level of oxygen in combustion processes, excess air monitoring, bakery ovens, and other applications. The OXY-FLEX is configurable to measure either 0% to 25% or 0% to 100% oxygen and supplies manual or automatic calibration. The OXY-FLEX Series is quick to install and integrate into existing systems, and specialist software is not required. The probe can be mounted directly on an aluminum or stainless steel electronic housing.

The SST Sensing OXY-FLEX Oxygen Transmitters are ideal for typical applications such as combustion control of industrial boilers, burning oil, gas, coal, or biomass; composting probes; and duct monitoring systems.
